title: The Energy Project | Tony Schwartz | Talks at Google
summary: Tony Schwartz of The Energy Project speaks at Google about managing energy rather than time. He draws on The Power of Full Engagement and his work on stamina and sustained performance.
why: HN commenters point to it in discussions of shorter workweeks and productivity, arguing that rest and energy matter more than hours.
